note: the seven census-009 repairs, re-read blind by readers that neither authored them nor found the original faults, with synset neighbours shown so comparative claims could be checked

failed.why: the repair still imported the scornful-pity sense - 'a verdict on the thing pitied' - where the gloss is plain 'deserving or inciting pity'
the repair called the sense an 'incursion' and handed 'patient' to encroaching alone, contradicting the gradual quality the gloss makes definitional

rounds.note: reader told both had been edited twice and warned against both drifting a third time and flattening the note into nothing

lesson: Both second-round failures were the SAME fault class as the original. A gloss-mismatch repair is the hardest kind, because the pull that produced the fault - the writer knows the word and its famous sense - is still acting on whoever writes the replacement. Two of the three repair rounds in this project have now needed a second pass, and both times on gloss-mismatch.
